feature: Painted scenes trace with sharp edges and keep their small things
summary: A scene or illustration Ask paints no longer comes back with grey rings round every shape, and its small things (lit windows, stars, lamps) survive as a few layers instead of vanishing.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default, picture model downloaded in Settings > Ask.

try.do: Open a blank picture and press Ask (Cmd-K).
Type 'draw the sun over mountains as a black silhouette badge with pines' and send.
Zoom in on the edge of a pine against the white.
Ask for 'an illustration of a city skyline at night' on a new blank picture.
Open the Layers list and find the lit windows layer.

evaluate: Do the edges of the pines and the sun look cleanly cut, with no grey outline?
Does the night skyline keep its lit windows?
Is one layer per window colour easier to work with than a layer per window would be?
Do sky gradients read as smooth bands, or still as ragged ones?
rough: A dark night sky still splits into a ragged band where its gradient is grainier than the smoothing allows; it was there before this change too.
Keeping smaller shapes also keeps a few crumbs along ridgelines: the layered sunset's judges named 'stray specks along the ridgelines' (82.4 against 85.6 before).

Before/after sheet compares two runs, so each row is a different painting of the same request; the badge old/new picture (2026-10-23-scene-tracing-badge-old-new.png) is the same painting traced both ways.
Held-out total 60.3 against 58.5 the run before and 61 best (drawings 69.5, the highest on this engine, clean 5.8 -> 6.4); the task's held-out item stays open against 61.
